name: Land Dispute Assistant
description: Bundles land-record tools with guidance for resolving ownership/boundary disputes. Example skill — wire it to agents on the Skills page (default_agents is empty, so it is inert until then).
instructions: When the citizen raises a land-record or ownership dispute, first fetch their Patta from DigiLocker to confirm ownership and survey number, then file a grievance with that exact survey number. Never assert ownership or boundaries without the Patta on hand.
